column1: Products: 35 items, 3 owners, 11 categories. Status is a formula: Out of Stock if Quantity = 0, Low Stock if Quantity <= Reorder Level, else In Stock.
Picture: an emoji placeholder. The app shows it as the product picture until a real photo is uploaded.
QR Value: unique code per product (TT-000001...). The app encodes this value into each QR code.
Expiry Date: blank for non-perishable items. Several items expire within 30 days of Nov 6, 2026 for testing the 'Expiring soon' list.
Sales: 14 days of sample sales (Oct 24 - Nov 6, 2026) for the sales trend and top-seller charts.
Utang: sample customer credit records with partial payments.
All names, prices and records are fictional sample data for a school prototype. Prices are approximate.
